newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Tuntex cuts 1996 profit target.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Tuntex cuts 1996 profit target.

text.p: Tuntex Distinct Corp said on Saturday it was cutting its 1996 pre-tax profit target to T$1.55 billion from T$2.34 billion.
The Taiwanese chemical fibre and construction firm also cut its 1996 sales target to T$20.61 billion from T$25.58 billion.
In the first six months of this year, Tuntex reported a pre-tax loss of T$712 million on sales of T$5.17 billion, against a year-earlier pre-tax profit of T$1.97 billion on sales of T$7.58 billion.
A company spokesman attributed the first-half loss to polyester fibre price falls this year and the poor construction sector.
